author: BoldAndBrash
body:
So recently, I noticed that donors no longer get many perks. We get a credit boost and enderchest slots. But really, I think donors should have a little more like special badges, or they can have perks like wings for more than 24 hours, etc.

Post some ideas below :p

title: Donor Perks

replies.author: Robin_DD_J
replies.body: Being able to join full games and pick what team you want to join is a pretty big perk?

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: Considering we almost never have to use them, I disagree. Avicus's player amount is dropping a little, and there are NEVER full games. Although, the pick your own team is not the big, it's useful/cool :)
